hypothesis: A1's nominated 2M improvement transfers to fresh20M on trn21 and an exact full1800 replicate on trn22, with both matched full20M candidate-minus-control deltas negative and their Decimal mean at most -0.001.
single_causal_change: Relative to each immutable 35c9 matrix-LR-0.015 host control, enable the complete A1 last-layer n-gram subsystem as one configuration: --ngram-ve --ngram-ve-layers=-1 --ngram-ve-table-mult 64 --ngram-ve-dim 128 --ngram-ve-trigram --ngram-ve-opt rmsprop --ngram-ve-flat-lr --ngram-ve-bf16 --ngram-ve-clip-exclude.
evidence: future authenticated Git-blob archives for both controls and the trn21 A1 screen

control.box_constraint: Every 20M delta is candidate minus its authenticated same-host control; throughput is never compared across hosts.

prerequisite_gate.screen_delta_definition: trn21 A1 fresh2M BPB minus trn21 control fresh2M BPB
prerequisite_gate.failure_action: DISCARD; neither confirmation arm may materialize
prerequisite_gate.binding: Each authorization must externally pin each archive commit/directory, finalization HEAD, verified core, authorization/request/runtime-job SHA256, source/prepare SHA256, retained checkpoint path/hash/size, and top-artifact SHA256. Completion self-report is never an authority. Every blob is read as a regular Git blob and compared exactly to those pins.

candidate.expected_diff: No candidate, prepare, evaluator, tokenizer or scoring change; tooling/proposal evidence lane only.

lane.label: fs-20260924-v2-a1-20m-pair-trn21-r1
lane.operation: Fresh20M evaluation in separate processes of the retained authenticated trn21 control and A1 checkpoints.
lane.next_gate: Only a strictly negative candidate-minus-control delta nominates position 2; zero or positive discards.

lane.label: fs-20260924-v2-a1-replicate-trn22-r1
lane.operation: Fresh20M evaluation of the retained trn22 control; exact A1 full1800 seed42 LNC2/world4 training; fresh2M and fresh20M evaluation of its finite retained checkpoint.
lane.prerequisite: Authenticated negative position-1 result plus all three prerequisite archives.

decision.delta_definition: candidate full20M BPB minus authenticated same-host control full20M BPB
decision.adopt: Both trn21 and trn22 deltas strictly negative AND Decimal arithmetic mean <= -0.001.
decision.discard: Either full20M delta is zero or positive.
decision.repeat: Both deltas are negative but their Decimal mean is > -0.001: repeat the matched full20M pair once under a separately approved proposal.

success_criteria.quality: Two strictly negative matched full20M deltas with Decimal mean <= -0.001.
success_criteria.correctness: Exact externally pinned provenance, source/evaluator/argv/env, seed42, full1800, finite checkpoints, exact token/byte counts, clean private process groups, immutable evidence and no unauthorized cleanup.

abort_conditions: Any prerequisite archive, checkpoint, source, prepare, request, runtime or evidence identity differs
The prerequisite trn21 fresh2M delta is greater than -0.001
The trn21 full20M delta is zero or positive
Any host is busy/dirty, violates one-run-per-host, or fails the disk floor
Any subprocess group is not quiescent before artifact/checkpoint hashing
Crash, timeout, NaN, over-budget training, nonfinite/missing checkpoint or count mismatch
